title: Executive Order No. 95, s. 2019
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 95

REORGANIZING THE NATIONAL CYBERSECURITY  INTER-
AGENCY COMMITTEE, AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 189
(S. 2015) AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 189 (s. 2015) created the National
Cybersecurity Inter-Agency Committee (NCIAC) chaired by the Executive Secretary,
and co-chaired by the National Security Adviser and Director-General of the National
Security Council (NSC) and the Secretary of the Department of Science and
Technology (DOST);

WHEREAS, the NCIAC is mandated to assess the vulnerabilities and risks of
the country’s cybersecurity, issue updated security protocols to all government
employees, for the proper handling, distribution and storage of all forms of
documents and communication, and enhance the public-private partnership to deter
cyberattacks, minimize cyber risks and increase cyber resiliency;

WHEREAS, Republic Act (RA) No. 10175 or the “Cybercrime Prevention Act
of 2012,” created the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) with
the mandate to coordinate the preparation of appropriate and effective measures to
prevent and suppress cybercrime activities;

WHEREAS, RA No. 10844, otherwise known as the “Department of
Information and Communications Technology (DICT) Act of 2015,” created the DICT
and transferred to it all powers and functions related to cybersecurity, including the
formulation of the National Cybersecurity Plan and the facilitation of international
cooperation on intelligence regarding cybersecurity matters, and attached the CICC
to the DICT for policy and program coordination;

WHEREAS, Section 31, Chapter 10, Title Ill, Book Ill of EO No. 292 (s. 1987)
or the “Administrative Code of 1987,” provides that the President shall have
continuing authority to reorganize the Executive Department in order to achieve
simplicity, economy and efficiency; and

WHEREAS, Section 17, Article VII of the Constitution provides that the

President shall have control over all the executive departments, bureaus and offices,
and shall ensure that the laws are faithfully executed;

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
NOW, THEREFORE, |, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing
laws, do hereby order:

Section 1. Reorganization of the NCIAC. Section 1 of EO No. 189 is hereby
amended to read as follows:

“There is hereby created a National Cybersecurity Inter-Agency Committee,
hereinafter referred to as ‘Committee,’ under the Office of the President, to be
chaired by the Executive Secretary, co-chaired by the Director-General of the
National Security Council and the Secretary of the Department of Information and
Communications Technology, and shall further be composed of the following
officials:

Members:

Secretary of the Department of Science and Technology;

Secretary of the Department of Energy;

Secretary of the Department of Finance;

Secretary of the Department of Foreign Affairs;

Secretary of the Department of the Interior and Local Government;

Secretary of the Department of Justice;

Secretary of the Department of National Defense;

Secretary of the Department of Transportation;

Secretary of the Presidential Communications Operations Office;

Commissioner of the National Telecommunications Commission;

Chairman of the National Privacy Commission;

Executive Director of the Anti-Terrorism Council — Program Management
Center;

Executive Director of the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating
Center; and

Governor of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.

The Committee may invite concerned public and private agencies or entities
to participate, complement, and assist in the performance of its functions.”

Section 2. NCIAC Secretariat. The NCIAC shall have a Secretariat to be
composed of officials from the member-agencies of the Committee. The Committee
shall provide for the guidelines for the creation of the Secretariat, including the
appropriate ranks of officials that shall comprise it.

 
Section 3. Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the remaining provisions not affected thereby shall continue to be in
full force and effect.

Section 4. Repeal. Pursuant to RA No. 10844, Sections 3, 4 and 5 of EO No.
189 are hereby repealed. Further, except to the extent modified by this Order, all
other provisions of EO No. 189 shall remain valid and subsisting.

Section 5. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 15tday of November , in the year of
our Lord, Two Thousand and Nineteen.

 

By the President:

—— momen ihe
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA

Executive Secretary

 

REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
PRRD 2016 — 012997
